Alicia (People Ops): Hey team — coordinating Nikhil's final week (last day Fri 2026-04-03). Need asset return + access removal schedule. COBRA timing? Any special steps for the contract overlap?
Leon: Thanks — confirmed last day is 2026-04-03. I'll lead the knowledge transfer: pair sessions Tue/Wed and a shadow session Thu 2026-04-02 10:00. Also want a short doc of outstanding work.
Samira: I'll own laptop pickup and SSO deprovision. @IT-OPS can you schedule account disablement for 2026-04-03 18:00 PT? Please keep Git repos read-only until then so we can grab diffs.
IT-OPS: Scheduled. We'll run deprovision script:
```
/usr/local/bin/deprovision --user nikhil --disable-at 2026-04-03T18:00Z
```
We'll export Okta logs and attach proof to the ticket.
Alicia (People Ops): Benefits update: healthcare (medical/dental/vision) continues through 2026-04-30 (end of month). COBRA notice will be emailed 2026-04-05 via hr-bot. Enrollment window is 60 days from that notice.
hr-bot: Payroll/benefits reminder: final paycheck processed 2026-04-15. Submit any outstanding expenses by 2026-04-06 EOD for inclusion. PTO payout follows policy.
Samira: Asset list to return: MacBook Pro S/N AMZ-12345, charger, USB-C hub, office keycard. UPS pickup scheduled 2026-04-06 (prepaid label). Confirm shipping address: 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107.
Leon: Adding handoff doc here: https://redwood.docs/handovers/nikhil-2026. Please paste links to any open PRs and a short migration plan for cron jobs.
Alicia (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled 2026-04-08 14:00 (Zoom) with People Ops. Draft agenda: manager feedback, transition notes, benefits/COBRA recap, final payroll clarifications, and any offboarding concerns. Should we invite the manager?
Samira: Also flagging infra: rotate service-account keys and any long-lived tokens tied to Nikhil on 2026-04-03. Reassign ownership to infra-team@redwood.com before rotation.
IT-OPS: Will rotate IAM keys and revoke tokens at disable time. Creating ticket INFRA-4421 and will post link once created.
Leon: Quick Q — can we keep Slack account visible (read-only) for two weeks to preserve context? Anything we should redact?
Alicia (People Ops): We'll disable sign-in at 2026-04-03 18:00 and preserve messages per retention. If Nikhil needs to export personal DMs, ask him to request by 2026-04-02. We won't redact company records.
Samira: Short final checklist I emailed Nikhil, posting here: 1) Laptop pickup 04/06 2) Charger + dongle 3) Keycard return 4) Repo ownership transfer 5) Service-account key rotation 6) Exit interview 04/08 7) Expenses in by 04/06 :white_check_mark:
Leon: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — please cc me on tickets and confirmations.
Alicia (People Ops): I'll follow up with calendar invites, UPS label, COBRA email copy, and closure note once all items complete. Posting status updates here. :sparkles:
